channel.title: Paksh: Sports
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Australia faces Springboks in one-off rugby test
item.description: Australia is set to play a one-off rugby test match against the new-look Springboks in Perth. Aiden Markram expressed hope that the Australian team will receive a respectful reception during the test series. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Ukraine Reaches First Billie Jean King Cup Final
item.description: Ukraine has reached the Billie Jean King Cup final for the first time, defeating defending champions Italy. The team secured their spot in the final against the Czech Republic after a decisive victory. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Ireland National Team to Play Israel After Player Vote
item.description: The Republic of Ireland's national football team will play against Israel following a player vote. The decision was confirmed by the team, with details emerging about internal discussions and disagreements leading up to the vote. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Stephen Curry Signs 2-Year, $116 Million Contract Extension
item.description: Stephen Curry has agreed to a two-year contract extension with the Warriors worth $116 million, according to an Associated Press source. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Army Rallies Past Temple with Three Touchdowns
item.description: Cale Hellums scored three rushing touchdowns to lead Army to a 21-17 victory over Temple in the Owls' American Conference opener. The game concluded with Army securing the win. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: UAB edges Navy 24-20 on late touchdown
item.description: Bam McReynolds scored two touchdowns, including a 48-yard go-ahead run, to lead UAB to a 24-20 victory over Navy. The decisive score came late in the game, securing the win for UAB. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Argos Defeat Bombers in Close Football Match
item.description: The Toronto Argonauts defeated the Winnipeg Blue Bombers with a final score of 30-28. The Argos secured the win with a late surge in the game. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The Ottawa Titans have taken a 2-1 lead in the championship series, playing in front of a sold-out crowd. The series is now returning to Ottawa. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Brisbane Lions Win Third Consecutive AFL Premiership
item.description: The Brisbane Lions have won their third consecutive Australian Football League (AFL) premiership, completing a comeback victory against Fremantle. The win marks a 'three-peat' for the Brisbane team. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Munich has been selected to carry Germany's bid to host the Olympic Games in either 2036, 2040, or 2044. Berlin has confirmed its withdrawal from the race to host the summer Olympics. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has announced Muthoot FinCorp as the title sponsor for India's home international matches. This partnership is set to run until 2028. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Brazil scored in the final seconds of a match to equalize against the Socceroos, denying them a victory. Nestory Irankunda had given the Socceroos the lead with a "stunning" free kick. The match took place in Townsville. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: India's Football Team Plays Panama in FIFA Friendly
item.description: The Indian men's national football team commenced a FIFA friendly window by playing against Panama. This match is part of their preparation for upcoming games against Brazil and Uruguay, as they continue their run towards the World Cup. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: England coach Thomas Tuchel has stated that Cole Palmer is "missing way too many camps." The comments were made in relation to absences from England training sessions. Kobbie Mainoo was also mentioned in relation to England absences. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Portugal is set to play Wales in the UEFA Nations League. Cristiano Ronaldo is participating in the match, with reports indicating he is aiming to reach 1,000 career goals before retirement. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Basketball legend Bob Pettit, NBA's first MVP, dies at 93
item.description: Bob Pettit, a celebrated basketball player and the NBA's first Most Valuable Player, has passed away at the age of 93. He is widely recognized as a basketball great. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Canada to Host Nations League Game and PWHL All-Star Game in Toronto
item.description: Canada is scheduled to play a Nations League game in Toronto. Additionally, the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL) has announced its first all-star game will take place in Toronto, a decision described as making "a lot of sense." Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The Canberra Raiders are reportedly preparing to offer player Hudson Young a revised four-year contract worth $4.4 million. The deal is expected to be tabled by the club. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Rugby League Player Brian To'o's Origin Axing Sparks Controversy
item.description: Rugby league player Brian To'o's exclusion from the Origin team has generated significant discussion and controversy. The specific reasons for his axing and the ensuing debate are highlighted in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Falcons Defeat Packers 35-14 in NFL Game
item.description: The Atlanta Falcons defeated the Green Bay Packers with a score of 35-14. Bijan Robinson was a key player in the Falcons' victory, described as running "roughshod" and "destroying" the Packers' defense. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Marco Jansen has joined an elite club, achieving a feat previously accomplished by only five players, including Sachin Tendulkar. The specific nature of this achievement is not detailed in the provided coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
